components.problem: Iteration 1 established exact torus spectral KRR (circulant-block embedding + FFT spectral shrinkage: O(N log N) train/predict, O(N) memory, closed-form solves) with a leakage-aware, resource-accounted benchmark -- on synthetic-from-physics [simulated] fields, because the allowed stack could not read the real NOAA Kaplan SST v2 netCDF-4 files. The significance ceiling of that result was imposed by the simulated regime: algorithmic properties (exactness, scaling, resource accounting) were measured, but real-data validation was roadmaped, not executed. Iteration 2 lifts the data constraint (h5py installed; real Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomaly fields 1856-2023, 36x72 5-degree grid, 2005 months, live in results/raw/real/ with the Nino3.4 index validated against the 1982/83, 1997/98, 2015/16 El Nino and 1988/89 La Nina events). The higher-significance research question: does the exact circulant-block spectral-KRR machinery, evaluated on REAL climate fields under future-blind temporal holdout and leakage-aware CV, (a) reconstruct masked real SST fields with calibrated split-conformal intervals, and (b) forecast the real Nino3.4 (ENSO) index at forecast horizons h=1..12 months against the standard persistence/climatology/AR(1) baselines -- i.e., a real-data replication AND a forecast arm that iteration 1 could not offer? Significance = real-data validation with honest skill scores on a high-impact climate target, while the algorithmic contribution (exact O(N log N) CPU-only spectral KRR, no FFT-kernel newness claim) is preserved and now empirically grounded on real observations.
components.method: Core method unchanged from iteration 1 and re-applied to REAL Kaplan SST v2 anomaly fields: (1) exact torus spectral KRR -- periodized kernel Gram is BCCB, solve via two FFTs and one pointwise division; spectral floor (PSD projection) applied and disclosed where the torus Gram has negative eigenvalues; exactness verified against the dense floored reference; free-boundary modeling gap measured per kernel and grid; (2) masked-input training via PCG with an EXACT free-boundary BTTB matvec (2N-1 mirror embedding) preconditioned by the floored-torus spectral inverse; (3) kernel-consistent functional: Nino3.4 index as the spectral mean of the predictor over the Trenberth box; (4) NEW extension arm (honestly scoped, no method-newness claim): frequency-domain transfer forecast -- per-Fourier-mode ridge regression mapping the current field spectrum to the h-month-ahead field spectrum (a spectral filter; same O(N log N) FFT machinery), with the index forecast as the box mean of the predicted field; baselines persistence, monthly climatology, AR(1). Evaluation additions: future-blind temporal holdout (train <= 2015-12, test 2016-01..2022-12) plus temporal-block K-fold CV for selection, and forecast skill metrics (RMSE, skill vs persistence/climatology).
components.experiment_design: Data: real Kaplan SST v2 anomalies (2005 months x 36 x 72) at results/raw/real/ (fields.npy + index.npy + meta.json), dataset.origin real-kaplan-sst-v2. Arms (same spine as iteration 1, real data): P0 pilot exactness gate on real fields; T1a masked reconstruction (random 10/30/50% + halo w1/2/4 masks, leave-one-field-out, split-conformal at target 0.90); T1b masked-input exact-free PCG; T2 Nino3.4 functional index regression under temporal-block CV vs zero-model (naive box mean) and direct RBF head; T3 forecast h in {1,3,6,12}: spectral transfer vs persistence / month-climatology / AR(1) -- skill scores reported; B baselines: sklearn exact KRR subsample / Nystrom / RFF on real pooled cells; S scaling (unchanged, O(N log N)/O(N), incl. 0.25-deg extrapolation vs 7 GB cap). Metrics: RMSE/R2, conformal coverage+width, forecast skill, per-arm wall-clock/RSS/est. flops/bytes; all artifacts carry dataset.origin+simulation_marker=None+real marker. Budget: FFT-only fits, real data 21 MB -- pipeline well under the 90-min envelope on 12 cores. Leakage: no random point splits across time; selection via temporal-block CV; all claims scoped to the real Kaplan record and honestly framed (no newness claim for FFT kernels or spectral regression).
